name: Field Image Tooltips
description: Displays images with tooltips that open referenced node content in a modal; ships the field_tooltips_data submodule (field type/widget/formatter).
project_description:
This module provides configured Paragraphs bundle that can be used in any content type in order to add image with tooltips on it. By clicking on this tooltip user will see attached node in Ctools modal window.

 Requirements (Drupal 7) 
 
 Paragraphs 
 Entity reference 
 jQuery Update 
 Features 
 Strongarm 
 
 Requirements (Drupal 8) 
 
 Paragraphs 
 Features 
 
 Instalation 
 Install as you would normally install a contributed Drupal module. See:

 https://drupal.org/documentation/install/modules-themes/modules-7 

 for further information.

 Configuration 
 
 Add a field Paragraphs to any entity, e.g. to a node using Embedded field

 widget. For that use the the usual "Manage fields" interface provided

 by the "field ui" module of Drupal,

 e.g. "Admin-> Structure-> Content types-> Article-> Manage fields". 
 On the field configuration form in the "Allowed Paragraph bundles" choose

 "Image with tooltips". "Default edit mode" setting should be set to "Open"

 and "Add mode" should be "Buttons". 
 You may also change default settings for fields in "Field image tooltips"

 Paragraphs bundle. For that use the the usual "Manage fields" interface

 provided by the "Paragraphs" module of Drupal e.g.

 "Admin-> Structure-> Paragraph Bundles-> Image with tooltips-> Manage fields". 
 
 More detailed instructions can be found here 

 Supporting organizations 
 Module developed on project JYSK
